data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). At all18, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100—not guaranteed recovery or optimal long-run income. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters, invite individual choices.
